title: Mixing: To You by Wings | 1979
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

The song ‘To You’ was mixed in stereo for Wings’ seventh studio album Back To The Egg on 5 April 1979.

This was the final studio sessions for the album, which was released on 8 June in the UK, and 11 June in the USA.
